Colby has already had 2 tubs of popcorn and 4 boxes of candy during the month, and he wants one tub of popcorn and one box of candy on the last Friday.

Calculate Colby’s spending so far:

- Movies on Fridays or Saturdays:  
  \[
  5\cdot \$10=\$50
  \]
- Movies on other days:  
  \[
  8\cdot \$7=\$56
  \]
- Popcorn:  
  \[
  2\cdot \$8=\$16
  \]
- Candy:  
  \[
  4\cdot \$2=\$8
  \]

Total spent:

\[
\$50+\$56+\$16+\$8=\$130
\]

Money remaining:

\[
\$150-\$130=\$20
\]

\[
\$8+\$2=\$10
\]

This leaves:

\[
\$20-\$10=\$10
\]

Each movie ticket on Friday costs \(\$10\), so Colby can see:

\[
\boxed{1\text{ additional movie}}
\]
